newsitem.title: UK: Ventspils reopens, Novorossiisk still closed.
newsitem.headline: Ventspils reopens, Novorossiisk still closed.

text.p: Latvia's Ventspils terminal on the Baltic Sea was open on Wednesday but Russia's Black Sea port of Novorossiisk remained closed, a shipping source said on Thursday.

Ventspils closed at midday on Tuesday due to strong winds and reopened on Wednesday afternoon. The Montrose finished loading crude at 1024 local time on Thursday and will be followed by the Progress, also loading crude.

Novorossiisk, Russia's leading oil export terminal, remains shut because of a heavy swell from the south. Bad weather has kept the port closed for much of February, leading to loading delays of about five days, traders said.
Other Black Sea oil ports at Odessa and Tuapse were operating normally.
